title: The people who employ are closing down
intro: Every tax comes from someone who produces. When the company that employs closes, the tax it collected disappears, the tax on the wages it paid disappears, and so does the spending of whoever earned those wages. It is the source drying up at the origin — and it is drying at the fastest rate in three years.

banks.title: In the same period, on the other side of the counter
banks.body: The four largest banks made R$ 107.8 billion in 2025. The three private ones together made R$ 86.55 billion — the highest nominal figure on record, against R$ 72.7 billion in 2024. Itaú alone made R$ 46.8 billion, more than Bradesco and Santander combined. Both figures are from the same year and the same country.

question: Where does the tax that rises every year come from, if the people who employ are closing 874,900 doors a quarter and 31% of active companies are in default?
